14736.overview: The mesmerizing force of Tetris returns with virtual style! This thrilling animated puzzler takes dexterity and split-second timing to the extreme with dimensional blocks and challenging planes. 3-D Tetris propels players at a demanding pace where quick response and strategy rule. Tetris devotees of all levels will crave this latest sensation of brain-teasing fun!

422807.overview: A unique crosswords game, made for PVB Coding Competition 2013, that makes clever use of the third dimension for its puzzles.
